operation.summary: Change a budget. A lower amount is a reduction and applies at once. A higher amount is a standing raise: an increment with an id, applied once, drawn from this device's headroom balance under an agent ceiling. A new scope or period never opens a period early. Needs the Budgets capability; explicit owner.configuration grant required

body.name: namespace
body.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build

body.name: amount
body.description: The new standing amount: {unit, atoms} (a whole number of the unit's smallest part) or {unit, amount} (plain decimal text); USD-6 is millionths of a dollar. Send it alone when it is a raise

body.name: generation
body.description: The rule document generation this change replaces (from a read); a change against an older one is refused with conflict. Left out, the current one is used

operation.returns: budget{id, scope{kind,id}, period, unit, amount (what stands for good), base, total (with this period's top-ups), rebalance, gate{agents_may_change, ceiling, set_by, gate_strength agent|grants|approver}, portions{cloud, devices{install:{portion, kind, headroom}}}, this_device{portion, headroom, used, remaining, period_id, resets_at, standing current|unanchored|not_open, frozen, holds_reclaim}, increments[], in_transit[], taken[]}, generation, increment{id, amount, lasts, replayed} when it was a raise; replayed: true when this Idempotency-Key already did it (nothing is worked out again)

generation.description: The rule document generation this change replaces (from a read); a change against an older one is refused with conflict. Left out, the current one is used

amount.description: The new standing amount: {unit, atoms} (a whole number of the unit's smallest part) or {unit, amount} (plain decimal text); USD-6 is millionths of a dollar. Send it alone when it is a raise

namespace.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
